### Prerequisites (listed separately)
1. redetermination ← recurring income (state). "The redetermined annual rate is fixed only after the countable income on the award matches the recurring income on file." — verbatim in annual_rate_redetermination_on_request_12c3ca8c only. Basis: recurring_countable_income_on_award_c27df52f describes the write in the sentence's words; award 27120.00 vs recurring income 28147.37. Connective "only after" intact.
2. redetermination ← net worth (state). "A redetermined annual rate is not recorded until the net worth on the award counts every one-time VA payment deposited since the award was granted." — verbatim in the same hub only, with a same-form restatement ("Said the other way …"). Basis: net_worth_redetermination_b8854786 (posting clause + redetermination) and the worksheet's deposits line; records show the release posted at gross and the refund uncounted. Intact.
3. net worth ← declaration (state). "Net worth is not redetermined until the award carries the veteran's own declaration of the one-time VA payments deposited to him, dated on the date of the most recent compensation release." — verbatim in net_worth_redetermination_b8854786 only (+ same-form restatement "So long as …"). Basis: one_time_payment_declaration_5038ba9f. Intact.
4. net worth ← recurring income (state). "Net worth is redetermined only after the countable income on the award reflects the recurring income on file as of the redetermination." — verbatim in net_worth_redetermination_b8854786 only. Basis: as edge 1. Intact.

## kb_to_source

Every normative sentence of the documents above traces to a source rule, parameter or tool contract. Reviewed:
- premium documents: "Premium reports are the medical expense reports on the award" and the net-worth table row "none 3 to 11 months before, some 12 to 23 months before" — the compute's banding (`premiums_recent_count` = 12-month count − 3-month count; `premiums_lapsed_count` = 24-month − 12-month); entailed.
- one_time_payment_declaration "Date of the declaration" — source "dated on the date of the most recent compensation release he declares"; equivalent.
- deposit_date_weight_in_one_time_declaration "applied to the releases less any fee taken out, as far as they count by the months they were paid for" — the factor's operand as the source orders it ("What counts is then weighed …"); not a pointer.
Specific prerequisite-side checks: cross-problem operational guidance — none; opening world state as policy fact — none (all figures hypothetical; the redetermination opening is the policy's own request definition from the source rule).
No addition, rewrite or omission found.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Policy-side notes:
- M1. The source prose "when the only premium reports are twelve to twenty-three whole months old" (both the net-worth and the redetermination rules) is narrower on its face than the compute, which ignores reports under 3 months; the KB carries the prose verbatim, adds "if it is the only kind present" in insurance_premium_reports_in_redetermined_rate_04b96510, and resolves it to the compute only in the net-worth document's table. A literal reader of the redetermination document alone, with 0-month care reports present, could reach "premiums add nothing" (rate 16301). The blind audit followed the table and matched the GT; recorded as a source-prose wording note.
- M2. The declaration is "dated on" the release date and aged "before the declaration" in prose, while the compute ages to NOW — the same prose-versus-compute pattern as task 0 N1; no tier moves in this world (11 whole months; 0 or 6 days).
- M3. The benefit income statement's state_due trigger ("stops or changes") is arguably met in this world (30 % increase decided 2026-09-24, release 2026-10-01) yet no statement is in the GT; no sentence of this tree waits on one. Policy-side scope note.

## dependency_form

Hop marks from the blind answer: all four hops state-derived; none pre-solved.
- Prerequisite sentences stand only on their blocked sides, in state form; restatements are same-form.
- No other problem's tool named anywhere (each of the seven tool names occurs only in its own policy's document); no route, roadmap, ordered list across problems or aggregated table of prerequisites.
- "Care costs reported" (redetermination) and "Not for a forward redetermination" (care-cost) are each policy's own source rule, rendered as the source states them.
- Titles/openings name general subjects; "…Annual Rate Redetermination at the Veteran's Request" names the on_request policy's request type (allowed).
- Computation documents give no hint of variation; factor documents state ladders as rules, name no customer tier, and do not point at the computation document.
- Depended-on documents are reachable with the state's own words (searches "countable income on the award recurring income on file", "net worth on the award one-time VA payment deposited", "declaration of one-time VA payments" returned them first).

**PASS.**
